result.summary: The page is mostly usable, but the clearest visual problem is a duplicated restaurant card in the “Fastest near you” row. A couple of minor contrast/clipping concerns are also present.

issues.description: “Green Bowl Poké” appears twice side-by-side with the same image, ETA, and delivery fee, making the carousel look like it is rendering duplicate data.
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate restaurant results before rendering and add a visual regression check for repeated cards in horizontal lists.

issues.description: Small green text such as “See all”, “€0 delivery”, and “€0.90 delivery” may be hard to read for low-vision users, especially at small sizes.
issues.suggestion: Increase font size/weight or darken the green to meet WCAG contrast guidance for small text.

issues.description: The rightmost category chip and parts of carousel cards are clipped at the screen edge; while this can indicate scrollability, the clipping looks slightly accidental where titles are cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent edge padding and a clearer peek amount/fade so partially visible items look intentional.
